name: io.github.AIdevdoer/wordlecup-mcp
title: Wordlecup
description: Football (soccer), NBA and NFL player data and Wordle-style player comparisons from wordlecup.today

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Search current football (soccer), NBA or NFL players by name, team/club, league, nationality, position or age range. Returns up to `limit` players with club, nationality, position, age, height and shirt number.

sport.description: football = soccer (FIFA / Premier League etc.), nba = basketball, nfl = American football

query.description: Part of the player's name, e.g. 'mbappe' or 'curry'

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Profile of one football (soccer), NBA or NFL player: league, club/team, nationality, position, age, height, shirt number and (football) preferred foot. Accent-insensitive name match.

sport.description: football = soccer (FIFA / Premier League etc.), nba = basketball, nfl = American football

tools.name: compare_players
tools.description: Compare a guessed footballer with a target footballer using Wordlecup's 8 clues: League, Club, Nation, Position, Age, Height, Shirt number, Preferred foot. Green = exact, yellow = close (same country's league, same league, same continent, same position group, age within 2, height within 3 cm, shirt number within 5), gray = no match. Arrows show whether the target's number is higher (up) or lower (down). Useful for building or explaining football Wordle puzzles.

target.description: The footballer being compared against, e.g. 'Mohamed Salah'

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Free browser sports trivia games on wordlecup.today (football/soccer, NBA, NFL): daily player Wordle, career path, chain puzzles, defense puzzles, jersey and logo quizzes, tier list makers. Returns names, one-line descriptions and links.

sport.description: Only games for this sport; omit for all

tools.name: how_to_play
tools.description: Rules of Wordlecup's daily mystery-player game for football (soccer), NBA or NFL: the 8 clues and what green, yellow and gray mean.

sport.description: football = soccer (FIFA / Premier League etc.), nba = basketball, nfl = American football
